info.title: PlaneMem artifact upload identity and original receipts
info.description: Source-only contract for two existing read operations. Does not describe multipart upload or binary download. Load this document and the artifact-original.json/artifact-comparison.json schema resources locally with their complete IDs. No validator, generator, build, test, product/API/database execution or release was performed.

servers.description: Relative Gateway base; configure the actual deployment origin and base path.

x-source-boundaries.description: Existing generic receipt POST reader limits raw JSON bytes before authentication. Shared handler parsers do not impose the clients' full-response byte budgets. Dedicated clients use their own deadlines; these two Gateway handlers have no dedicated 30-second/two-slot read guard. No raw-header aggregate budget or uniform strict duplicate-header validation is asserted.

get.summary: Read the current verified upload identity and limits
get.description: Require verified Bearer scope, nonblank authenticated client, actual artifact.write, unexpired session and a Policy decision. Return the five-field current identity, exact canonical session expiry, configured max_bytes and current artifact.read/data.restricted.read hints. This synchronous handler does not query project existence, Artifact rows, receipt storage or objects; success can occur without a configured artifact storage reader/writer. It reserves no key or version and grants no future upload permission. Use this to prepare a new original request; never silently replace the identity of an already dispatched request. The synchronous handler checks expiry after router authorization/audit and before producing hints. They describe the current session and do not guarantee authorization for a later upload.
get.x-current-http-parser: No query parameters or command input are accepted. Idempotency-Key, If-Match and If-Match-Version are explicitly rejected. Send no body or other cache/range/write/encoding headers: this legacy GET does not enforce the directory's full forbidden-header/framing guard and leaves GET body bytes unread. It does not implement 304/206 or conditional identity reads.

200.description: Complete current authority hints with empty source_refs and no outer revision/JSON etag/HTTP ETag. max_bytes is a configured content-upload limit from 0 through 1 GiB, not a JSON response limit or a guarantee that storage will accept the upload. can_read/can_read_restricted describe capabilities, not current object visibility or export permission.

400.description: INVALID_INPUT for query/input/write conditions. ARTIFACT_UPLOAD_CONTEXT_INVALID when trusted identity or expiry cannot be represented is currently mapped to 400 by the generic command error mapper, not 500. Both are nonretryable; this document records that existing mapping.

500.description: Unexpected INTERNAL_ERROR from the command boundary, serializer default retryable=true. No partial identity is returned.

503.description: WORKBENCH_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE or AUDIT_PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE at outer boundaries, retryable=true. The identity handler does not require artifact storage readiness.

post.summary: Observe the historical outcome for one complete original upload request
post.description: Read-only POST requiring verified Bearer scope, a nonblank authenticated client, actual artifact.write and Policy approval. Body identity is an exact five-field equality precondition on the trusted session; it never supplies authority. Persistent lookup checks current parent visibility, the identity/key receipt record, canonical command fingerprint, saved result and current/historical snapshot consistency. If the current artifact advanced, return the original saved version, never replace it with current metadata. Restricted current or saved classification still requires data.restricted.read. On a missing append receipt, the target current artifact must be visible before not-observed can be returned. This lookup does not take the writer's original-request advisory lock, so a concurrent save may commit after a not-observed observation. Neither response nor error authorizes a new key, new identity, changed parameters or automatic resubmission. The handler performs no upload/object read and has no explicit session-expiry recheck after database work.
post.x-current-http-parser: No URL query fields are accepted. Idempotency-Key, If-Match and If-Match-Version are explicitly forbidden; the original request_key and expected_version remain nested in command. Send application/json. Legacy generic POST parsing reads a nonempty JSON object within 1 MiB before authentication, without a dedicated Content-Type/Content-Encoding, strict UTF-8 or duplicate-JSON-key guard. Other cache/range/expected-version headers do not establish conditions. The stricter saved-pack receipt HTTP checks are not applied here.

requestBody.description: Exact original identity and complete original create/append command, including stable request_key and declared sha256/size. No content bytes, partial key-only query, new identity or top-level idempotency_key/expected_version. The current configured upload limit does not narrow historical command.size. Unknown JSON fields are rejected by shared parsers.

200.description: Complete recorded or not-observed envelope, both status 200. recorded has original public metadata, replayed=true, content_state=not-checked and one artifact/version source; not-observed has only original identity/command/status and empty sources. No outer revision/ETag; nested metadata ETag and trace remain historical while outer trace identifies this read. No object availability/hash verification occurs. Absence is an observation, not proof the original save failed.

400.description: INVALID_JSON for malformed/nonobject/missing/oversized generic JSON body; INVALID_INPUT for invalid complete original, unsupported query, forbidden write headers or exhausted append expected_version. retryable=false. Validation errors never mean not-observed.

404.description: ARTIFACT_NOT_FOUND for missing/deleted/invisible parent/current artifact, including an append target with no receipt; ARTIFACT_VERSION_NOT_FOUND when a recorded receipt's historical version is missing. retryable=false. Do not convert these errors to not-observed.

409.description: IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED when the same original identity/key has different canonical parameters, or ARTIFACT_LEGACY_UNVERIFIED for missing trustworthy saved metadata. retryable=false. Preserve the original request; no synthesized success or partial receipt.

500.description: ARTIFACT_STORED_INVALID for corrupt/inconsistent saved receipts, command fingerprints, snapshots or reader output (retryable=false). Unexpected command-boundary INTERNAL_ERROR has serializer default retryable=true. No partial receipt or absent observation is returned.

503.description: ARTIFACT_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE for no configured receipt reader or non-ContractError persistent storage failure; WORKBENCH_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE or AUDIT_PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE at outer boundaries. These sources set retryable=true. No in-memory fallback or fabricated not-observed result.

GatewayBearer.description: Verified issuer token, actual artifact.write and nonblank authenticated client plus Policy approval. Administrator role alone does not satisfy artifact.write. Scope headers constrain allowed claims or configured fallback project; body identity/expected headers cannot impersonate another account/client. Upload identity explicitly requires unexpired session; receipt authorization uses existing policy expiry checks with no final handler recheck.

TenantId.name: x-tenant-id
TenantId.description: Exact authorized tenant; general metadata scope identifier, not necessarily ULID.

ProjectId.name: x-project-id
ProjectId.description: Exact authorized project. Receipt storage checks current parent visibility; upload-context hints alone do not establish project existence.

TraceParent.name: traceparent
TraceParent.description: Nonempty opaque value takes precedence over x-trace-id. This legacy boundary does not parse W3C Trace Context or require both headers to agree. Supply a value compatible with shared response trace rules.

TraceId.name: x-trace-id
TraceId.description: Used when traceparent is absent/empty; if both are absent/empty the server generates trace_http_<ULID>. Shared parsers impose stricter trace rules than generic selection.

ExpectedActorId.name: x-expected-actor-id
ExpectedActorId.description: Independently optional exact comparison to verified actor. Receipt body identity is mandatory and separately compared even if this header is absent.

ExpectedClientId.name: x-expected-client-id
ExpectedClientId.description: Independently optional exact comparison to verified client, never credentials. Both routes require an authenticated client claim.

NoStore.description: Application JSON policy; pre-application proxy/parser responses are outside this contract.

SuccessTrace.description: Equals outer body.trace_id. Receipt metadata can retain a different original saved trace.

ErrorTrace.description: Command-boundary errors include this header; early body/authentication/input failures may omit it. Preserve the error body trace_id.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Existing error envelope. No global 16 KiB server limit is implied. Raw retryable flags differ from stricter client mappings and never prove an original upload failed.

Error.description: Application error with no partial successful identity or receipt. Earlier proxy/HTTP parser failures may have another representation.

Unauthenticated.description: UNAUTHENTICATED for missing/rejected Bearer token; retryable=false. WWW-Authenticate and early x-trace-id headers are not guaranteed.

Denied.description: DENIED or ARTIFACT_ACCESS_DENIED for unauthorized scope/expected identity, original five-field identity mismatch, missing actual artifact.write/verified client, expired session where checked, Policy denial or restricted saved data. retryable=false; never an absent-receipt observation.

RateLimited.description: RATE_LIMITED from the general actor/path limiter, retryable=true. No dedicated two-slot identity/receipt limiter or Retry-After header is promised.
